name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
benefit:
##### ***Financial Assistance***

- Financial assistance shall be sanctioned to meet the expenses towards major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals.
- Financial assistance shall be provided to meet the expenses towards travelling and accommodation outside the state for treatment for self and or wholly dependent family members.
- The maximum financial assistance under this
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be any Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa. - The applicant must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The applicant must have an annual family income from all sources not exceeding ₹2,00,000/- per annum. - The applicant must be not less than 50 years of age. **Relaxation** The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.
